Page 2, line 28, by striking < establishment. >> and 3 inserting < establishment. > 4 2. Page 2, after line 28 by inserting: 5 < Sec. ___. NEW SECTION . 157.12D Supervised haircutting. 6 1. A person engaged exclusively in the practice of 7 supervised haircutting is not required to receive a license 8 issued under section 157.3. 9 2. A person shall not engage in the practice of or 10 supervised haircutting except at an establishment that is 11 licensed pursuant to section 157.11 or an establishment 12 established in a residence pursuant to section 157.6. 13 3. A person shall not engage exclusively in the practice 14 of supervised haircutting unless the person has completed four 15 hours of education related to Iowa cosmetology law and rules, 16 sanitation, scalp diseases and disorders, and infection control 17 related to hair cutting, as determined by the board by rule. 18 The board shall ensure that at least one education program for 19 supervised haircutting is available online. 20 4. An establishment shall disclose in writing prior to a 21 consumer’s receipt of haircutting services from an unlicensed 22 provider that the provider is not licensed. The disclosure 23 shall be clearly legible and state: “The services you are 24 receiving are from an unlicensed provider under the supervision 25 of a licensed provider.” 26 5. In addition to any other remedy provided by law, in 27 an action based on an injury alleged to have been caused by 28 an unlicensed person performing supervised haircutting, a 29 prevailing party may recover reasonable attorney’s fees and 30 receive other equitable relief as determined by the court. 31 6. In addition to any other disciplinary powers established 32 pursuant to this chapter, the board may, when the board has 33 probable cause to believe that an unlicensed person performing 34 supervised haircutting has violated a provision of this 35 -1- H 1325.2020 (2) 91 ss/ko 1/ 2 #1. #2. chapter, order an establishment to immediately cease providing 1 supervised haircutting. The board shall conduct formal 2 proceedings pursuant to this chapter to determine whether the 3 issue has been corrected, and whether to suspend, revoke, or 4 reinstate the establishment’s license. 5 7. The owner of an establishment shall be responsible for 6 ensuring the education, training, skills, and competence of a 7 person performing supervised haircutting at the establishment. 8 8. For the purposes of this section: 9 a. “Supervised haircutting” means the practice of cutting 10 hair in a licensed establishment under the supervision of a 11 licensed cosmetologist or barber, or a person licensed to 12 perform barber styling. 13 b. “Supervision” means within the presence of a licensed 14 cosmetologist or barber, or a person licensed to perform barber 15 styling, and the licensee is available to assist in providing 16 services. 17 Sec. ___.
